subject: learning/code-startup-fast-forward-main
statement: The shared startup launcher fetches origin/main and fast-forwards local main without switching the original checkout or merging into a feature branch; the new worktree still starts from origin/main.
intent: Give wrappers a current mainline source without clobbering in-progress work.
rationale: A plain pull would merge into the current branch. Fetch plus ff-only on local main updates a checked-out main and leaves other branches and uncommitted files put.
fit_criterion: Tests cover fetch failure, fast-forward of checked-out main, and leaving a dirty or feature-branch main unchanged while still creating the worktree from origin/main.
